system.name: Crab
system.one_liner: A unified audio-visual scene understanding model trained with explicit cooperation among tasks, through a reasoning-rich instruction dataset and interaction-aware LoRA heads.

content.variant_note: one model hub with four colour-tabbed task cards, each pairing a user prompt with a real audio-visual input and output; the hub holds a crab mascot and a thought cloud
content.argues: One model can do temporal localization, spatial localization, spatio-temporal reasoning and pixel-level understanding of audio-visual scenes.
content.subject: Crab as a central hub with four task cards, each with a prompt, a video with waveform and the output

content.reading_order: The eye lands on the glowing yellow hub with the crab, goes up to the task header, then follows the dotted colour arrows to the four cards, reading each card as prompt, input video with waveform, then output.

layout.arrangement_note: A central yellow-glow box with the crab and the word MLLMs, a task header with a thick down arrow above it and a colour legend below it; four tinted cards in the corners (temporal and spatial at the top, spatio-temporal reasoning and pixel-level at the bottom), each with a coloured title tab on its top edge and a colour-matched dotted arrow from the hub. Inside a card: user icon and prompt, input video with waveform, and the output at the right or below.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a unified model as a central hub with one colour-coded card per task: each card pairs a user prompt with a real input and output, and the same colour runs through tab, tint, prompt, dotted arrow and legend; a mascot in the hub brands the model.
lessons.suits: Teasers of generalist or multi-task models whose claim is the breadth of tasks one model covers, with real inputs and outputs for each task.

evidence: We present Crab, a unified audio-visual scene understanding model with explicit cooperation, which can complete various audio-visual tasks.
the model can focus on multiple interaction aspects such as temporal, spatial, and pixel-level
for spatio-temporal reasoning task, the label is no longer single words, but includes explicit reasoning process

summary: Crab is a unified audio-visual scene understanding model trained with explicit cooperation among tasks. Figure 1 is a hub-and-spoke teaser. At the centre, a header listing the audio-visual task acronyms (AVE, AVVP, AVQA, AVS, ARIG) points down to a glowing yellow box holding a red crab mascot, a thought cloud of four coloured nodes and the word MLLMs. Dotted colour-coded arrows lead to four tabbed cards in the corners: temporal localization, spatial localization, spatio-temporal reasoning and pixel-level understanding. Each card pairs a user prompt with a real video and waveform and the output (text, a box, a long reasoning answer or masks); one colour per task runs through tab, tint, prompt, arrow and the legend under the hub.
summary_zh: Crab 是显式任务协作的统一视听场景理解模型。图以中央的螃蟹吉祥物和 MLLMs 为枢纽，用四种颜色的虚线箭头通向四张卡片：时间定位、空间定位、时空推理、像素级理解；每张卡片给出用户提示、视频与波形和输出，下方图例按颜色标出任务。
notes: Prior kinds kept (contribution-mosaic, scope-overview); the variant is capability-cards because hub-and-spoke is a variant of scope-overview. The meaning of the thought cloud (four coloured nodes joined by solid and dashed lines) is not stated in the context file: the nodes carry the four task colours and the caption speaks of an interaction-aware LoRA structure, but no label ties them together. The acronym row is coloured like the four task types, but which acronym belongs to which type is not stated.
